comment: scoped to the five buy-side-relevant servers (skipping Chronograph/PitchBook/Egnyte/Daloopa/Morningstar/LSEG),
and wired into AYVID's runtime via data_primitives/mcp/.
Each server URL is opt-in: it only becomes active when its matching env var is set

mt-newswires.description: Real-time market news feed. Preferred shock-detection source when configured; falls back to existing news_scraper.py otherwise.

aiera.description: Earnings call transcripts and analyst Q&A. Used by earnings-analysis and earnings-preview skills.

factset.description: Multi-asset fundamentals, consensus estimates, IV-implied moves.

moodys.description: Credit ratings, sovereign + corporate. Used by the ETFs & bonds asset class for rating-aware sizing.

sp-global.description: Capital IQ tear sheets, analyst dispersion, sector benchmarks.
